description: This file defines the interface S3ClientInterface for AWS S3 client operations, including methods for presigned URLs, object existence checks, stream registration, object deletion, uploading, copying, and bucket region determination.

classes.name: S3ClientInterface
classes.description: Interface for AWS S3 client operations, extending AwsClientInterface with methods for presigned requests, object management, stream registration, and bucket operations.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Creates a pre-signed URL for an S3 command object.

methods.name: getObjectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to an object identified by its bucket and key.

methods.name: doesBucketExist
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if a bucket exists by name.

methods.name: doesBucketExistV2
methods.description: Checks if a bucket exists using S3's HeadBucket operation.

methods.name: doesObjectExist
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if an object exists by name.

methods.name: doesObjectExistV2
methods.description: Checks if an object exists using S3's HeadObject operation.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapper
methods.description: Registers the Amazon S3 stream wrapper with the client.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapperV2
methods.description: Registers the S3 stream wrapper using doesObjectExistV2 and doesBucketExistV2.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjects
methods.description: Deletes objects matching a list, prefix, or regex.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjectsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes objects matching criteria.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads a file, stream, or string to a bucket.

methods.name: uploadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads a file, stream, or string to a bucket.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies an object to a different location, using multipart if needed.

methods.name: copyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously copies an object to a different location.

methods.name: uploadDirectory
methods.description: Recursively uploads all files in a directory to a bucket.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously uploads a directory to a bucket.

methods.name: downloadBucket
methods.description: Downloads a bucket to a local directory.

methods.name: downloadBucketAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously downloads a bucket to a local directory.

methods.name: determineBucketRegion
methods.description: Returns the region of a specified bucket.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionAsync
methods.description: Returns a promise for the region of a specified bucket.
